task: A friend shares big news. React with happiness and ask one question.
say: Guess what? I just got engaged!
zh: 朋友分享了一个大消息。开心地回应，再问一个问题。对方说：“你猜怎么着？我刚订婚了！”
example: No way, congratulations! That's amazing news. Have you set a date yet?

task: A colleague is sick. React with sympathy.
say: I've got the flu. I feel awful.
zh: 同事生病了。表示同情。对方说：“我得了流感，难受死了。”
example: Oh no, poor you. Go home and get some rest. Hope you feel better soon.

task: A friend got the job they wanted. React with happiness.
say: I got the job!
zh: 朋友得到了想要的工作。开心地回应。对方说：“我拿到那份工作了！”
example: That's brilliant, well done! You totally deserve it. We'll have to celebrate.

task: A colleague had a bad morning. React with sympathy and ask a question.
say: My car broke down on the motorway this morning.
zh: 同事今天早上很倒霉。表示同情，再问一个问题。对方说：“今天早上我的车在高速上抛锚了。”
example: Oh no, that's the worst! Are you okay? Did you have to get it towed?

task: Someone likes your shoes. Accept the compliment.
say: I love your shoes!
zh: 有人喜欢你的鞋。接受夸奖。对方说：“我好喜欢你的鞋！”
example: Aw, thanks! They're super comfy too. Best thing I've bought all year.

task: A friend has booked a holiday. React with happiness and ask a follow-up question.
say: We've just booked a trip to Japan!
zh: 朋友订了一次旅行。开心地回应，再追问一个问题。对方说：“我们刚订了去日本的行程！”
example: Oh, lucky you! When are you going? You're going to love the food.

task: A colleague says their week was hard. Show sympathy and give them a chance to talk.
say: It's been a rough week, honestly.
zh: 同事说这周很难熬。表示同情，给对方说下去的机会。对方说：“说实话，这周太难熬了。”
example: Ah, sorry to hear that. What's been going on? Want to grab a coffee and have a moan?

task: You asked a colleague about their weekend. The chat stalls. Ask a good follow-up question.
say: Yeah, good.
zh: 你问同事周末过得怎么样，对方只回了一句，聊天卡住了。问一个好的追问。对方说：“嗯，挺好的。”
example: Nice! Get up to anything fun, or was it a quiet one?

task: Someone compliments your English. Accept the compliment modestly.
say: Your English is really good!
zh: 有人夸你的英语好。谦虚地接受夸奖。对方说：“你的英语真好！”
example: Oh, thanks! I'm still working on it. The Kiwi slang still catches me out sometimes.

task: A colleague did something surprising. React with surprise and show interest.
say: I ran my first half marathon on Sunday.
zh: 同事做了件让你吃惊的事。表示惊讶，再表示兴趣。对方说：“我周日跑了人生第一个半马。”
example: Seriously? That's huge! How did you feel at the end? Can you still walk?

task: A colleague complains about something at work. Agree lightly.
say: The coffee machine's broken again.
zh: 同事抱怨办公室的一件事。轻松地表示同意。对方说：“咖啡机又坏了。”
example: Again? That's the third time this month. Looks like it's instant coffee for us today.

task: A friend tells you they are having a baby. React with happiness and ask a follow-up question.
say: We're having a baby! Due in March.
zh: 朋友告诉你他们要有宝宝了。开心地回应，再追问一个问题。对方说：“我们要有宝宝了！预产期三月。”
example: Oh, that's wonderful news, congratulations! How are you feeling? Do you know if it's a boy or a girl?

task: A neighbour shares sad news. React with gentle sympathy.
say: Our dog passed away last week.
zh: 邻居告诉你一个难过的消息。温和地表示同情。对方说：“我们家的狗上周去世了。”
example: Oh, I'm so sorry. That's really hard, they're part of the family. How long did you have him?

task: A colleague tells you something surprising about their past. React with surprise and ask a question.
say: I used to be a professional dancer, believe it or not.
zh: 同事告诉你一件关于他过去的惊人往事。表示惊讶，再问一个问题。对方说：“信不信由你，我以前是职业舞者。”
example: No way! I would never have guessed. What kind of dancing? Do you still do it?

task: You asked a colleague if work is busy. They give a short answer and the chat stalls. Ask a more specific follow-up question.
say: Yeah, flat out.
zh: 你问同事最近忙不忙，对方回答很短，聊天卡住了。问一个更具体的追问。对方说：“是啊，忙疯了。”
example: Sounds full on. Is that the new project, or just lots of meetings?

task: A friend complains about their landlord. Show sympathy and offer a suggestion.
say: My landlord still hasn't fixed the heater. It's freezing.
zh: 朋友抱怨房东。表示同情，再给个建议。对方说：“我房东还没修暖气，冻死了。”
example: Oh, that's rubbish, especially in this weather. Have you put it in writing? Sometimes that gets things moving.

task: Your manager praises your presentation. Accept the compliment and share the credit.
say: You did a great job on that presentation today.
zh: 经理夸你的演讲。接受夸奖，并把功劳分给团队。对方说：“你今天的演讲做得很好。”
example: Thanks, that means a lot! The team did most of the hard work, though. I just got to talk about it.

task: A friend has just bought a house. React with happiness and ask a follow-up question.
say: We finally bought a house!
zh: 朋友终于买了房。开心地回应，再追问一个问题。对方说：“我们终于买房了！”
example: That's huge, congratulations! Where is it? When do you get the keys?

task: You asked about rugby, but the other person isn't interested. Switch topic smoothly.
say: Nah, not really. I don't watch much sport.
zh: 你问起橄榄球，但对方不感兴趣。自然地换个话题。对方说：“不太看，我不怎么看体育。”
example: Fair enough, me neither, really. So what do you get up to on the weekends?

task: A colleague tells you they have lost their job. React with sympathy and offer support.
say: I found out today I'm being made redundant.
zh: 同事告诉你他被裁员了。表示同情，并提供支持。对方说：“我今天得知我被裁员了。”
example: Oh, mate, I'm really sorry. That's a horrible thing to hear. If you need a reference or anything, just let me know.

task: A friend shares a surprising plan. React with surprise and show interest.
say: I've just quit my job to travel for a year.
zh: 朋友分享了一个让人吃惊的计划。表示惊讶，再表示兴趣。对方说：“我刚辞职了，要去旅行一年。”
example: Wow, good on you! That's brave. Where are you heading first?

task: A colleague tells you a joke about themselves. Laugh and add to it.
say: I told my wife I'd fix the dishwasher. That was in March.
zh: 同事讲了个自嘲的笑话。笑一笑，再接着说。对方说：“我跟老婆说我会修洗碗机，那是三月份的事了。”
example: Ha! Sounds like my shed door. It's been on my list for two years now. Is she still waiting?

task: A friend loves the dinner you made. Accept the compliment with humour.
say: Wow, you cooked all this? You should open a restaurant!
zh: 朋友很喜欢你做的晚饭。幽默地接受夸奖。对方说：“哇，这些都是你做的？你应该开家餐厅！”
example: Ha, thanks! I'd be broke in a week, though. I only know how to cook about five dishes.

task: You asked your friend's quiet partner how their trip was. They give a one-word answer. Ask a more open question.
say: Fine.
zh: 你问朋友那位比较内向的伴侣旅行怎么样，对方只回了一个词。问一个更开放的问题。对方说：“还行。”
example: Good to hear. What was the highlight? I've always wanted to go down to Fiordland.

task: A friend is nervous about tomorrow. Encourage them.
say: I'm so nervous. I've got a job interview tomorrow.
zh: 朋友对明天的事很紧张。鼓励对方。对方说：“我好紧张，明天有个面试。”
example: You'll be great, honestly. You know your stuff. Just be yourself, and let me know how it goes!

task: A neighbour shares bad news. Show sympathy and ask a follow-up question.
say: Someone broke into my car last night.
zh: 邻居告诉你一个坏消息。表示同情，再追问一个问题。对方说：“昨晚有人撬了我的车。”
example: Oh no, that's awful. Did they take much? I'll keep an eye out on our side of the street.

task: A colleague is learning your language. React with surprise, encourage them and ask a question.
say: I've been learning Mandarin for six months!
zh: 同事在学你的母语。表示惊讶，鼓励对方，再问一个问题。对方说：“我已经学了六个月中文了！”
example: No way, that's awesome! How are you finding the tones? They drive most people crazy.

task: A friend passed their driving test after a few tries. React with happiness and a little humour.
say: I finally passed my driving test! Third time lucky.
zh: 朋友考了几次终于通过驾照。开心地回应，再带点幽默。对方说：“我终于通过驾照考试了！第三次走运了。”
example: Yes! Congrats! Third time's the charm. So, when are you driving me to work?

task: A colleague complains about Auckland. Agree partly, then add something positive.
say: Honestly, Auckland's way too expensive. I don't know why anyone lives here.
zh: 同事抱怨奥克兰。部分同意，再说点积极的。对方说：“说真的，奥克兰太贵了，真不知道为什么还有人住这儿。”
example: Yeah, it's not cheap, that's for sure. But you can't beat the beaches. Twenty minutes and you're at the sea.

task: You have talked about work for too long and the chat is dying. Switch to a new topic smoothly.
say: Yeah, well. Work's work.
zh: 你们聊工作聊太久了，对话快冷场了。自然地换一个新话题。对方说：“嗯，工作嘛，就那样。”
example: Ha, true. Enough about work, then. Got anything fun planned for the summer?

task: A colleague tells a surprising story. React, then share a similar short story.
say: I once got stuck in a lift for three hours.
zh: 同事讲了一个让人吃惊的经历。回应，再分享一个类似的小故事。对方说：“我有一次被困在电梯里三个小时。”
example: Three hours? That's my nightmare. I got stuck for twenty minutes once and I was already planning my escape through the roof.

task: A colleague compliments your personality. Accept it with humour.
say: You're always so calm. How do you do it?
zh: 同事夸你的性格。幽默地接受。对方说：“你总是那么淡定，你是怎么做到的？”
example: Ha, that's just my face! Inside I'm usually panicking. A run in the morning helps, though.

task: A friend shares hard family news. Show gentle sympathy and offer help.
say: My mum's in hospital, so it's been a bit full on.
zh: 朋友分享了家里的困难。温和地表示同情，并提供帮助。对方说：“我妈住院了，所以最近事情挺多的。”
example: Oh, I'm really sorry. That's so stressful. How's she doing? If you need a meal dropped round, just say.

task: A colleague makes a joke about IT people. Laugh along and joke back.
say: You IT people, always telling us to turn it off and on again!
zh: 同事拿 IT 人开玩笑。一起笑，再开个玩笑回去。对方说：“你们 IT 的人，总叫我们关机重启！”
example: Ha, guilty! But you'd be amazed how often it works. Please don't tell anyone, it's our biggest secret.

task: A colleague won a baking competition. React with happiness and tease them a little.
say: I won the office bake-off, can you believe it?
zh: 同事赢了办公室烘焙比赛。开心地回应，再开个小玩笑。对方说：“我赢了办公室烘焙比赛，你敢信吗？”
example: Of course I can, that lemon slice was unreal! Does this mean you're baking for every team meeting now?

task: Someone apologises for talking a lot. Reassure them and show interest.
say: Sorry, I've been talking your ear off!
zh: 有人为自己说太多而道歉。安慰对方，并表示你感兴趣。对方说：“不好意思，我一直在说个不停！”
example: Not at all, I'm enjoying it! So what happened in the end? Did you get the boat fixed?

task: At a party you asked a stranger if they live nearby. They only give one-word answers. Try a different, more open question.
say: Yep.
zh: 派对上你问一个陌生人是不是住在附近，对方总是只回一个词。换一个更开放的问题。对方说：“嗯。”
example: Nice. How long have you been around here? I'm still looking for a decent café, so I'm open to tips.

task: A colleague is very negative about their day. Show sympathy, then lift the mood with humour.
say: Ugh, Mondays. Everything that could go wrong today went wrong.
zh: 同事对今天非常不满。先表示同情，再用幽默缓和气氛。对方说：“唉，周一。今天能出错的事全出错了。”
example: Oh no, sorry. Well, the good news is it can only get better. And I've got chocolate in my drawer if that helps.

task: A friend shares a surprising coincidence. React, add humour and ask a question.
say: I just found out my new neighbour was my maths teacher at high school!
zh: 朋友分享了一个惊人的巧合。回应，加点幽默，再问一个问题。对方说：“我刚发现我的新邻居是我高中的数学老师！”
example: No way! Small country, eh? Has he asked to see your homework yet?

task: A colleague makes a joke about the weather. Laugh and add your own joke.
say: Forecast says sunny. So I've brought my raincoat, my umbrella and my gumboots.
zh: 同事拿天气开玩笑。笑一笑，再加一个你自己的玩笑。对方说：“天气预报说晴天，所以我带了雨衣、雨伞和雨靴。”
example: Ha, smart move. I trusted the forecast once. Walked home looking like I'd jumped in the harbour.
